notes.short: Evil at both ends, good in the middle
notes.about: Evil is named in the first and last lines, good in the two between: not what is evil but what is good; the one who does good is of God, the one who does evil has not seen God.

lines.words: do not imitate what is evil,
The one who does good is of God;
the one who does evil has not seen God.

notes.evidence: Boys finds evil at the extremes of the verse, first and last, with good in the members at its centre.

cites.quote: Here we have evil in the extreme, and good in the central members
cites.read: the 1824 printing, in the scan at archive.org/details/tactica-sacra
